description:
VENN: Do Everything All Terrain Bike

Like the Venn diagram, the Venn is a confluence of ideas. The Venn is the intersection of geometric progress, without completely leaving the past behind. A practical design without eschewing the advantages of modern mountain bike features. All this ads up to offer the performance improvement you have been looking for without requiring a country mile to turn.

The versatile Venn combines thoughtfully routed external cables for easy maintenance, yet state of the art titanium manufacturing and tube manipulation. The geometry is not super long, with just the right head angle, especially with the weight of gear attached on the front end. As you can see, the seat tube angle isn't a crazy steep a$$ hatchet, i.e, just perfect for whatever direction you're headed.

The Venn will fit up to 29x2.8" tires with geometry listed using a 130mm suspension fork. Featuring UDH and T-type compatibility, CNC tapered head tube, double butted top and down tube and tapered / butted chainstays. The full lower yoke is 3D printed titanium with integrated bridge and cable guides.

The Venn is considerably more adventure oriented than any other Turner Bike and is equipped with just enough threaded inserts welded into the frame in all the right places.

Features

CUSTOM SHAPED TITANIUM TUBESET

With the custom tapered chainstays, these subtle features set the Turner Ti ahead of the pack when it comes to ride tuning.

DESIGNED IN THE USA

Every aspect of this Turner Ti frame is designed and engineered in the USA. From the gorgeous CNC tapered head tubes to the proprietary dropouts, we have designed every aspect of the frame.

As you probably figured out from the great price and long list of standard features, this frame is imported. What drew us to this factory was their ability to taper and create butted titanium tubing, and their massive CNC capabilities allowing us to create exactly what we wanted with out cookie cutter head tubes, bottom brackets and dropouts. Even our chainstay bridge is CNC out of billet to be super thin and not create a mud shelf!

T47 BB

T47 will easily fit the larger DUB 29mm and 30mm spindles creating a stiffer crank assembly, which is up to 18% lighter than the traditional steel spindle system.

Specifications subject to change without notice.

Turner Bikes crash replacement program

Sometimes accidents happen and you may need to replace a non-warranty damaged frame. We know how much you love your Turner Bike and understand the burden of having to replace a non-warranty damaged bike frame or part, Turner Bikes will make replacement parts available at a minimum charge to the original owner. Turner Bikes does this at its sole discretion and reserves the right to refuse this offer.

Our customer service rocks and our bikes ride like no other, but in the end, we want it to fit you. If you cannot get comfortable on your new Turner Bike within 5 days of receiving it, give us a call and we will work out a solution, you may only need a different stem, or length of seat post. If that won't work, a different size frame can be swapped out.
